examples.en: I heard that during the war people received rice through rationing.

examples.ko: 이 영화는 한국 배급사가 따로 있어요.
examples.en: This film has a separate Korean distributor.

examples.ko: 마을 사람들이 줄을 서서 식량 배급을 기다려요.
examples.en: The villagers stand in line waiting for food rations.
Water is handed out only twice a day.
The rations were delayed, so the children went hungry.
In the army, they hand out clothes and shoes.

explain: '배급'은 부족한 물건을 정해진 양만큼 나눠 줄 때 써요. 영화나 책을 극장과 서점에 내보내는 일도 '배급'이라서 '배급사'라는 말이 있어요. 광고지를 공짜로 돌리는 건 '배포'예요.

phrases.en: The government distributed rice to families in need.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사 '배급'에 '-하다'를 붙인 동사로, 물건을 나눠 주는 사람이 주어예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb form, where the subject is the one handing out supplies.

phrases.en: People stood in line and received their rations.
phrases.nuance_ko: 나눠 주는 쪽이 아니라 받는 쪽에서 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used from the side of the person who receives the ration.

phrases.en: Which company is this movie's distributor?
phrases.nuance_ko: 영화를 극장에 내보내는 회사를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The company that sends a film out to theaters.

explain_en: Official handing out of scarce goods like food or water. 배급 is for handing out scarce goods in fixed amounts. Sending films or books out to theaters and stores is also 배급, which is why 배급사 (distributor) exists. Handing out flyers for free is 배포.

en: to be produced; to be yielded

examples.en: This car is produced in Korea.
Rice is produced most in autumn.

examples.ko: 새 휴대폰이 다음 달부터 생산될 거예요.
examples.en: The new phone will be produced starting next month.
The products made go straight to the airport.

examples.ko: 이 지역에서는 사과가 많이 생산되고 있어요.
examples.en: Many apples are grown in this region.
The factory stopped, so goods couldn't be produced.

explain: 공장에서 만들든 농장에서 키우든 '생산되다'를 써요. 짝말은 '소비하다(consume)'예요. 집에서 만드는 음식에는 쓰지 않고 '만들어지다'를 써요.

phrases.example: 이 빵은 매일 아침 가게에서 만들어져요.
phrases.en: This bread is made at the shop every morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: '생산되다'보다 쉽고 일상적인 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An easier, everyday alternative to 생산되다.

phrases.en: This toy is mass-produced in a factory.
phrases.nuance_ko: 많은 양을 한꺼번에 만든다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means produced in large quantities.

phrases.en: That model is no longer produced.
phrases.nuance_ko: 더 이상 만들지 않는 물건에 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for products that are no longer made.

explain_en: Passive: goods or crops made in quantity (제주도에서 생산돼요) Whether made in a factory or grown on a farm, use '생산되다'. Its counterpart is '소비하다' (consume). For food made at home, use '만들어지다' instead.

dis.h: made in quantity; goods and crops
gh: made as a work: film, show, product
made in a factory; formal, industrial

p.n: 제조되다 stresses factory manufacturing; 생산되다 is broader and also covers crops.

t90.ax: This car is produced in Korea.

en: to be sold; to go on sale

examples.ko: 다음 달부터 시판되는 신제품을 미리 써 봤어요.
examples.en: I tried out the new product that goes on sale next month ahead of time.

examples.ko: 이 약은 허가 없이는 시판될 수 없어요.
examples.en: This medicine can't be put on the market without approval.

examples.ko: 시판되기 전에 안전 검사를 꼭 받아야 해요.
examples.en: It must pass a safety inspection before it goes on sale.
The newly released snack is very popular.

examples.ko: 해외에서 시판되고 있는 제품이 한국에도 들어왔어요.
examples.en: A product sold overseas has now come to Korea too.

examples.ko: 이 제품이 시판되면 가장 먼저 사고 싶어요.
examples.en: When this product goes on sale, I want to buy it first.

explain: '판매되다'는 팔리는 모든 경우에 쓰지만, 시판되다는 가게에서 일반 사람에게 팔기 시작한다는 느낌이 있어요. 주로 새 제품이나 약 소식에서 나와요.

phrases.en: This snack is on sale in stores now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 가게에서 팔고 있다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means it is currently being sold in stores.

phrases.en: The new product went on sale this week.
phrases.nuance_ko: 새 제품이 처음 나올 때 쓰기 좋은 모양이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A good form for when a new product first comes out.

phrases.en: The company will put the new product on the market next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 팔리는 쪽이 아니라 파는 회사가 주어일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the seller, not the product, is the subject.

explain_en: Go on sale — newly launched product, news and business tone. 판매되다 covers anything that is sold, but 시판되다 carries the sense of starting to be sold to the general public in shops. It appears mostly in news about new products or medicine.

dis.h: go on sale commercially; new product launch
gh: be sold; neutral, formal-leaning, business tone
be sold; everyday spoken, items selling well

p.n: 시판되다 stresses the product is released to the market; 판매되다 just says it is sold.

t90.ax: The newly released snack is very popular.

en: to be used regularly; to be patronized

examples.en: This app is widely used by students.
That restaurant is a favorite of office workers.
It is a medicinal herb that has been used regularly since long ago.

examples.ko: 애용되는 교통카드는 버스와 지하철에서 다 써요.
examples.en: The popular transit card can be used on both buses and subways.

examples.ko: 이 길은 자전거 타는 사람들에게 애용될 거예요.
examples.en: This road will be favored by people who ride bikes.

examples.ko: 한때 애용됐던 물건이 지금은 박물관에 있어요.
examples.en: An item that was once used regularly is now in a museum.

explain: '많이 쓰이다'보다 사람들이 좋아해서 자주 쓴다는 느낌이 있어요. 주어는 사람이 아니라 물건, 가게, 서비스예요. 쓰는 사람을 주어로 하면 '애용하다'를 써요.

phrases.en: This transit card is widely used all over the country.
phrases.nuance_ko: 많은 사람이 좋아해서 쓴다는 뜻으로 '널리'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with '널리' to mean many people like and use it.

phrases.example: 그 가게는 동네 사람들에게 애용되고 있어요.
phrases.en: That shop is regularly used by the neighborhood people.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금도 계속 자주 쓰인다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means it is still being used often right now.

phrases.en: This word is used a lot these days.
phrases.nuance_ko: '애용되다'보다 일상적이고, 좋아하는 느낌은 없어요.
phrases.nuance_en: More everyday than 애용되다, without the feeling of liking it.

explain_en: It has more of a liked and regularly used feeling than 많이 쓰이다. The subject is a thing, shop, or service rather than a person. If the user is the subject, 애용하다 is used instead.

en: to be distributed; to circulate; to be marketed

examples.en: This fruit is distributed across the country.
Fake goods are circulating in the market.
These vegetables go straight from the farm, so they're fresh.

examples.ko: 유통된 지 오래된 제품은 사지 마세요.
examples.en: Don't buy products that have been on the market for a long time.
False information circulated on the internet.

examples.ko: 새 음료는 다음 달부터 편의점에서 유통될 거예요.
examples.en: The new drink will be on sale at convenience stores from next month.

explain: 물건이 만든 곳에서 가게를 거쳐 소비자에게 가는 흐름이에요. 말로는 '팔리다', '나오다'를 쓰기도 해요. 식품 포장에 '유통 기한'이 적혀 있는데, 가게에서 팔 수 있는 마지막 날이에요.

phrases.example: 이 제품은 전 세계에 널리 유통돼요.
phrases.en: This product is widely distributed around the world.
phrases.nuance_ko: '널리'를 붙여 많은 곳에서 팔린다는 뜻을 더해요.
phrases.nuance_en: 널리 adds the sense that it is sold in many places.

phrases.example: 그 책은 지금 시장에 유통되지 않아요.
phrases.en: That book is not on the market now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건이 가게에서 팔리지 않는다고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say an item is not sold in stores.
phrases.en_equiv: to not be on the market

phrases.example: 그 과자는 전국 마트에서 유통되고 있어요.
phrases.en: That snack is being sold in supermarkets nationwide.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 시장에 나와 팔리고 있다는 진행의 느낌을 줘요.
phrases.nuance_en: Gives a sense that goods are on the market and circulating right now.

explain_en: Passive, goods or money moving through markets and trade channels. Goods flow from the producer through shops to consumers. In speech, '팔리다' or '나오다' are used too. Food packages show '유통 기한', the last date a shop may sell it.

dis.h: goods get distributed; passive, no actor
gh: sell goods through distribution channels; actor

p.n: 유통하다 needs an actor and an object, so the same sentence does not work.

t90.ax: Fake goods are circulating in the market.

en: to be rented; to be leased

examples.en: This building is rented out as offices.
The empty shop was rented out last month.

examples.ko: 임대된 집은 마음대로 고치면 안 돼요.
examples.en: You must not alter a rented house as you like.

examples.ko: 이 땅은 오 년 동안 임대될 예정이에요.
examples.en: This land is scheduled to be leased for five years.

examples.ko: 임대되기 전에 집을 한번 보러 갈까요?
examples.en: Shall we go see the house before it's rented out?
The car is already rented out, so it's not here now.

explain: 임대는 집주인이 빌려주는 쪽의 말이고, 빌리는 쪽은 '임차'라고 해요. 그래서 집이 임대되었다는 말은 누군가 빌려 쓰고 있다는 뜻이에요. 일상에서는 '세를 놓다', '월세로 나오다'도 많이 써요.

phrases.example: 이 건물은 지금 사무실로 임대되어 있어요.
phrases.en: This building is currently rented out as offices.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 누군가 빌려 쓰고 있는 상태를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to describe the current state of being rented by someone.

phrases.example: 이 집은 다음 달에 임대될 예정이에요.
phrases.en: This house is scheduled to be rented out next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 빌려줄 계획을 알릴 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An expression used to announce a coming rental.

phrases.en: The shop hasn't been rented yet.
phrases.nuance_ko: 빌려 가는 사람이 아직 없다는 뜻의 부정 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A negative expression meaning no one has rented it yet.

explain_en: '임대' is the lender's side, and the borrower's side is '임차'. So a house described as 임대되다 is now being rented by someone. In everyday speech '세를 놓다' and '월세로 나오다' are also common.

en: to be treated; to be sold; to be served

examples.en: Imported fruit is also handled at this market.
That was treated as a simple mistake.
Dangerous items must be handled with care.

examples.ko: 지각 세 번은 결석 한 번으로 취급된다고 해요.
examples.en: They say three late arrivals are counted as one absence.

examples.ko: 한 번 쓴 제품은 중고로 취급되니까 값이 내려가요.
examples.en: A used product is treated as secondhand, so its price drops.

examples.ko: 중고 책은 새 책과 같은 값으로 취급되지 않아요.
examples.en: Used books are not treated at the same price as new books.

explain: 사람보다는 일, 물건, 상품이 어떻게 다뤄지는지에 써요. '중고로 취급되다', '이 가게에서 취급되다'처럼 말해요. 사람이 억울하게 대접받는 건 '취급당하다'예요. 가게 안내문의 '취급 품목'이라는 말도 자주 보여요.

phrases.en: The items our store sells are fruits.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가게에서 파는 물건의 종류를 말하는 명사 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A noun phrase for the kinds of goods a shop deals in.

phrases.en: Opened items are treated as used.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건이 어떤 상태로 다뤄지는지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Says how an item is classified or handled.

phrases.en: Alcohol isn't sold at this store.
phrases.nuance_ko: 그 가게나 곳에서 다루지 않는다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means the shop or place does not deal in it.

explain_en: Passive: goods are sold or something is regarded in a way. It is used for how things, jobs or products are handled rather than for people, as in '중고로 취급되다' or '이 가게에서 취급되다'. When a person is treated unfairly, use '취급당하다'. You also often see '취급 품목' (items handled) on store notices.

dis.h: be handled or regarded in some way
gh: be regarded as something, usually unfairly

p.n: 취급당하다 implies suffering, so it does not fit a positive meaning.

t90.ax: That was treated as a simple mistake.

en: to be returned; to be restored

examples.en: The profits were returned to the employees.
The donations are being given back to the local community.

examples.ko: 모든 문제가 돈으로 환원되는 건 아니에요.
examples.en: Not every problem can be reduced to money.
It takes time to be restored to the original state.
The system was changed so that taxes are returned to citizens.
They promised that the earnings would go back to society.

explain: 환원되다는 가져간 것이 다시 돌아가거나, 복잡한 것이 하나로 줄어들 때 써요. 이익, 세금, 기부처럼 돈이 사회로 돌아갈 때 많이 나와요. 일상에서는 '돌아가다'가 쉬워요.

phrases.en: Taxes should be returned to the residents.
phrases.nuance_ko: 받은 돈이나 혜택이 다시 사람들에게 돌아갈 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing for money or benefits going back to the people.

phrases.en: The changed settings were restored to the original.
phrases.nuance_ko: 바뀐 것이 처음 상태로 다시 돌아갈 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something changed goes back to its first state.

phrases.en: The proceeds go to neighbors in need.
phrases.nuance_ko: '환원되다'보다 쉽고 일상에서 자연스럽게 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Easier than 환원되다 and natural in everyday speech.

explain_en: Passive form; donations or benefits are returned to people (사회에 환원되다) This is used when something taken goes back, or when something complex is boiled down to one thing. It is common for profits, taxes, and donations flowing back to society. In everyday speech, '돌아가다' (go back) is easier.

en: to be degraded; to be demoted

examples.ko: 일 년 만에 부장에서 과장으로 강등됐어요.
examples.en: In just one year he was demoted from department head to section chief.

examples.ko: 우리 팀은 성적이 나빠서 2부 리그로 강등될 것 같아요.
examples.en: Our team seems likely to be relegated to the second division because of poor results.
Nobody knows why he was demoted.
If your rank is lowered, your pay goes down too.

examples.ko: 그가 큰 실수를 해서 강등됐다는 소문이 있어요.
examples.en: There's a rumor that he made a big mistake and was demoted.
Even after being demoted, he worked hard.

explain: 사람의 직급이나 팀의 리그 등급이 내려갈 때 써요. 반대말은 '승진하다'(직급)나 '승격되다'(리그)예요. 억울한 느낌을 더하고 싶으면 '강등당하다'라고도 해요.

phrases.en: He was demoted because of a big mistake.
phrases.nuance_ko: 억울하거나 힘든 느낌을 더할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adds a feeling of unfairness or hardship.

phrases.example: 이번 시즌에는 우리 팀이 강등되지 않았어요.
phrases.en: Our team wasn't relegated this season.
phrases.nuance_ko: 내려가지 않고 자리를 지켰다는 뜻의 부정형이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The negative form meaning it kept its place.

phrases.en: The results are bad, so we're at risk of being demoted.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 내려갈 수도 있는 상황을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for a situation where a drop might happen.

explain_en: It is used when a person's rank or a team's league level goes down. The opposites are '승진하다' (rank) and '승격되다' (league). To add a sense of unfairness you can also say '강등당하다'.

en: to be performed; to be conducted; to be held

examples.en: The graduation ceremony is held in the auditorium.
The opening ceremony was held yesterday morning.

examples.ko: 내일 새 건물의 준공식이 거행될 거예요.
examples.en: The completion ceremony for the new building will be held tomorrow.
Because it rained, the event was held indoors.
I watched the awards ceremony being held in Seoul on TV.
The funeral is being held quietly.

explain: '거행되다'는 '열리다'보다 딱딱해요. 사람이 아니라 '식', '행사'가 주어일 때 써요. 사람이나 단체가 직접 치를 때는 '거행하다'를 써요.

phrases.en: The graduation ceremony is held in the auditorium.
phrases.nuance_ko: '거행되다'보다 덜 딱딱한 말로, 일상에서 행사나 모임에 두루 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A less formal word than 거행되다, used for events and gatherings in everyday speech.

phrases.en: The anniversary ceremony was held on a grand scale.
phrases.nuance_ko: 크고 화려한 식을 말할 때 '성대하게'와 함께 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often paired with '성대하게' (grandly) for large, splendid ceremonies.

phrases.example: 결혼식은 다음 주 토요일에 거행될 예정이에요.
phrases.en: The wedding is scheduled to take place next Saturday.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 열릴 식이나 행사를 알릴 때 쓰는 미래 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A future form used to announce an upcoming ceremony or event.

explain_en: Passive, formal; a ceremony like graduation is held. 거행되다 is stiffer than 열리다 for an event being held. The subject is the ceremony itself, such as 식 or 행사. When a person or group does the holding, 거행하다 is used instead.

gh: a show or concert is staged

p.n: 공연되다 is for shows, not ceremonies.

t90.ax: The funeral is being held quietly.

en: to be designed; to be invented; to be created

examples.ko: 이 의자는 허리가 아픈 사람을 위해 고안됐어요.
examples.en: This chair was designed for people with back pain.

examples.ko: 이 방법은 백 년 전에 고안되었어요.
examples.en: This method was devised a hundred years ago.

examples.ko: 쉽게 쓸 수 있도록 고안된 앱이에요.
examples.en: It's an app designed to be easy to use.
I'm curious how this kind of tool was invented.

examples.ko: 새 제도가 고안되면 많은 사람이 도움을 받을 거예요.
examples.en: If a new system is devised, many people will be helped.

examples.ko: 처음에는 놀이로 고안돼서 지금까지 전해 와요.
examples.en: It was first devised as a game and has been passed down until now.

explain: '고안하다'의 받는 쪽 말로, 만든 사람이 아니라 만들어진 물건이나 방법에 초점을 맞춰요. '~을/를 위해 고안되다'는 제품 소개나 설명서에 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: This tool was made for children.
phrases.nuance_ko: '고안되다'보다 쉽고 일상적이에요. 새로 궁리했다는 느낌은 약해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Easier and more everyday than 고안되다, but with less of a feeling of newly thought-out design.

phrases.example: 이 방법은 어린이를 위해 고안된 방법이에요.
phrases.en: This is a method designed for children.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뒤에 오는 명사를 꾸미는 말로, 방법이나 제품을 소개할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Modifies the following noun; often used when introducing a method or product.

phrases.example: 이 의자는 오래 앉아도 편하도록 새롭게 고안됐어요.
phrases.en: This chair was newly designed to be comfortable even when sitting for a long time.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이전에 없던 것이 처음 만들어졌다는 점을 강조해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Emphasizes that something that didn't exist before was newly created.

explain_en: Be invented or thought up — passive, formal, written. This is the receiving side of 고안하다: the focus is on the thing that was made, not the person who made it. '~을/를 위해 고안되다' (designed for ~) appears often in product descriptions and manuals.

t90.ax: It's an app designed to be easy to use.

examples.en: Try changing this sentence into the active voice.

examples.ko: 시험에 능동태와 피동태를 구별하는 문제가 나왔어요.
examples.en: The exam had a question about telling active and passive voice apart.
In an active-voice sentence, the subject performs the action.
The teacher wrote active-voice example sentences on the board.

examples.ko: 이 책은 능동태와 피동태를 쉽게 설명해 줘요.
examples.en: This book explains active and passive voice in an easy way.

examples.ko: 능동태로 쓰면 글이 더 힘 있게 읽혀요.
examples.en: Writing in the active voice makes the text read more forcefully.

explain: 문법 수업이나 시험에서 쓰는 말이고, 일상 대화에서는 거의 나오지 않아요. 짝이 되는 말은 '피동태'(피동문)이에요.

phrases.en: In an active voice sentence, the subject acts directly.
phrases.nuance_ko: 문법 설명에서 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing in grammar explanations.

phrases.en: Try to tell active and passive voice apart.
phrases.nuance_ko: 반대되는 짝 '피동태'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used together with its opposite, 피동태 (passive).

phrases.en: This text is mostly written in the active voice.
phrases.nuance_ko: 문장을 어떤 형태로 썼는지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say what form a sentence is written in.
phrases.en_equiv: to write in the active voice

explain_en: This is a grammar-class and exam term that rarely comes up in everyday conversation. Its counterpart is '피동태' (passive voice).

en: to close at a deadline; to reach the cutoff

examples.en: Applications closed yesterday.
Registration closes this evening.
Hand in the documents before it closes.
Recruitment had closed, so I couldn't apply.
I didn't know the event had closed.
Once registration closes, they don't accept anyone more.

explain: 마감하다는 사람이 끝내는 것이고, 마감되다는 시간이나 인원이 다 차서 저절로 끝나는 거예요. 명사 '마감'으로 '마감일', '마감 시간'처럼 더 많이 써요. 자리가 다 찼을 때도 '선착순 마감'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: Apply before the spots are closed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 끝나기 전에 서두르라고 말할 때 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use this to urge someone to hurry before the cutoff.

phrases.en: You cannot sign up for a class that is already full.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이미 신청이 끝난 것을 꾸며서 말하는 모양이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This modifier form describes something whose sign-up has already ended.

phrases.en: This class closes on a first-come, first-served basis.
phrases.nuance_ko: 먼저 온 사람부터 받다가 자리가 차면 끝난다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This means spots go to early arrivals and it closes once they are full.

explain_en: Passive, things reach cutoff and stop accepting. '마감하다' is something a person does to wrap things up, while '마감되다' happens by itself when time runs out or spots fill up. The noun '마감' is more common, as in '마감일' or '마감 시간'. Full spots are also called '선착순 마감'.

dis.h: reaches its deadline; no longer accepting
gh: gets wrapped up or completed properly

p.n: 마무리되다 says the process is wrapped up, not that a deadline cut it off.

en: to be quoted; to be cited

examples.en: That line is often quoted in books.
This paper has been cited in many studies.
We put quotation marks on the quoted parts.
I was surprised that my post was quoted in the news.
It's a problem if something is quoted without a source.

examples.ko: 발표 자료에 인용될 문장을 골라 보세요.
examples.en: Pick sentences to be quoted in the presentation.

explain: 다른 사람의 말이나 글, 자료가 내 글이나 발표 안에 가져와 쓰일 때 써요. 내가 가져다 쓰는 쪽은 '인용하다'예요. 보고서에서는 출처를 꼭 밝혀야 하고, 말로 옮길 때는 '그 사람이 이렇게 말했어요'처럼 쉽게 말해요.

phrases.example: 이 시는 노래 가사에 자주 인용돼요.
phrases.en: This poem is often quoted in song lyrics.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여러 곳에서 반복해서 가져다 쓸 때 '자주'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: '자주' is added when something is quoted repeatedly in many places.

phrases.en: Look up the source of the quoted words.
phrases.nuance_ko: '인용된'으로 바꿔 가져다 쓴 말이나 글을 꾸밀 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The modifier '인용된' describes words or text that were quoted.

phrases.en: I quoted a sentence from a book in my report.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가져다 쓰는 사람이 주어일 때는 '인용하다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use '인용하다' when the person doing the quoting is the subject.

explain_en: When someone else's words, writing or data are brought into another text or talk. The person who borrows it uses '인용하다'. Reports must name the source; in speech people simply say 'he said this'.

examples.en: The bank's computer network stopped, and work was paralyzed.
You need a password to log in to the school network.

examples.ko: 전산망 오류 때문에 표를 살 수 없었어요.
examples.en: I couldn't buy a ticket because of a network error.
They are replacing the government offices' computer network.

examples.ko: 전국 병원이 하나의 전산망으로 연결돼 있어요.
examples.en: Hospitals across the country are connected through a single computer network.

examples.ko: 전산망은 점검 시간에는 쓸 수 없어요.
examples.en: The network can't be used during maintenance hours.

explain: 은행, 학교, 관공서처럼 기관이 컴퓨터를 서로 이어 정보를 주고받는 시스템을 말해요. 누구나 쓰는 인터넷과 달리 기관 내부의 업무용 망이라는 느낌이 강해요. 일상에서 '전산'이라고만 해도 같은 뜻으로 써서, '전산 오류'처럼 말해요.

phrases.en: Registration is delayed because of a computer network error.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시스템에 문제가 생겼을 때 안내문이나 뉴스에서 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often appears in notices and news when a system has a problem.

phrases.en: The school built a new computer network.
phrases.nuance_ko: 기관이 시스템을 새로 만든다는 뜻의 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing for an institution newly setting up a system.

phrases.example: 전산 문제 때문에 서류를 못 뗐어요.
phrases.en: I couldn't get the documents because of a computer system problem.
phrases.nuance_ko: 전산망 대신 짧게 말하는 일상적인 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A short everyday way to say the same thing as 전산망.

explain_en: It refers to the system through which organizations such as banks, schools and government offices connect computers to exchange information. Unlike the public internet, it feels like an internal work network. In daily talk people also say just '전산' in the same sense, as in '전산 오류' (system error).
